policies.B1: An operator fulfills fundamental fleet capacity standards when maintaining an active fleet count of at least 10 coaches.
policies.B2: Safety and compliance standards are fulfilled when a transit firm records a driver training completion rate of at least 90 percent this year together with an active fleet count of at least 12 coaches.
policies.B3: An operator attains preferred carrier ranking if it fulfills fundamental fleet capacity standards and concurrently satisfies safety and compliance standards.
policies.B4: Top-level safety clearance is granted when an operator holds preferred carrier ranking along with an active ISO 39001 certification.
policies.D1: Selection for cross-border transit assignments requires a carrier to possess top-level safety clearance.
policies.B5: Criteria for high-volume operators are met if a provider maintains a private jet fleet of at least 15 jets, or reports annual revenue of at least 20,000,000 USD this year, or holds an ARGUS safety rating of at least 5 stars.
policies.B6: Charter standing at the elite level is awarded when an aviation firm fulfills criteria for high-volume operators while possessing an active Wyvern Wingman certificate.
policies.D2: Awarding of executive VIP transportation agreements requires a charter company to demonstrate charter standing at the elite level.
policies.B7: Regional expansion funding eligibility is granted if a charter firm recorded at least 100 charter flights completed last quarter, operates a private jet fleet of at least 15 jets, and maintains a customer satisfaction score of at least 90 percent.
policies.B8: Preferred hangar lease eligibility is extended to any flight company that possesses regional expansion funding eligibility.
policies.D3: Terminal expansion at airports is approved for aviation businesses that secure preferred hangar lease eligibility.
policies.B9: Authorization for urban transit routes is granted to any transport vendor holding an active municipal transit license.
policies.B10: Passenger punctuality benchmarks are satisfied when a train operator achieves an on-time arrival rate of at least 90 percent this year.
